settings.heading: Sculpted Saddle Leather & Architectural Warmth
settings.description: Individually hand-burnished Florentine calfskin, solid aged brass, and precision dimmable lighting. Bespoke pieces engineered for the world's most distinguished interiors.

settings.heading: Signature Handcrafted Leather Lamps
settings.description: Each lamp is sculpted from vegetable-tanned full-grain leather that gains an extraordinary patina over decades.

settings.heading: Where Master Saddle Stitching Meets Warm Amber Glow
settings.story_quote: Leather is not merely a material; it is a living medium that captures time, touch, and light.
settings.story_body: Every Oreliaa fixture is wrapped by hand in vegetable-tanned leather sourced from historic family tanneries in Tuscany. Hand-waxed Irish linen thread is stitched using traditional saddlery techniques that date back over two centuries.

settings.heading: The Mayfair Leather Architect Desk Lamp
settings.subtitle: Featuring 360-degree brass swivel articulation and hand-stitched English bridle leather stem.
